evidence.quoted_text:
if inventory[unit]["service_type"] == "simple":
            self.refuse("simple service completion has no declared execution "
                        "bound; preflight refuses this topology")
        service_timeout = inventory[unit]["service_timeout_seconds"]
evidence.reason: At the pinned code, `_completion_budget` rejects only `service_type == "simple"` and then checks the declared service timeout; it does not reject a bounded oneshot whose `RemainAfterExit=yes` keeps the unit active after the first start. In that topology the restored timer cannot restart the still-active unit, so the required second strictly advancing completion cannot occur, yet preflight proceeds. This is a real defect in the existing completion-bound preflight, not a new policy scope.
